published.citation: Delrez et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 136352 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 5664 +/- 61 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021NatAs...5..775D/abstract

temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 136352 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: HR 5699 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 5699 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: HR 5699 is not in the catalogue; burnashev: BS 5699 is not in part2), so the colour is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
